description: This file defines a report parser class for generating VAT declaration reports in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for retrieving and processing accounting and tax data.

classes.name: tax_report
classes.description: A report parser class for VAT declaration, extending rml_parse.rml_parse, with methods to gather and process accounting data for reports.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and sets up local context with helper methods.

methods.name: _get_lines
methods.description: Generates a list of account lines with tax data, including hierarchical codes and general account info.

methods.name: _get_period
methods.description: Retrieves the name of an account period given its ID.

methods.name: _get_general
methods.description: Fetches summarized tax amounts, debits, credits, and account info for a specific tax code and period list.

methods.name: _get_codes
methods.description: Recursively retrieves hierarchical tax codes based on parent and company filters.

methods.name: _add_codes
methods.description: Associates tax code sums with account list entries for specified periods.

methods.name: _get_company
methods.description: Returns the company name based on form data.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Returns the company's currency name based on form data.

methods.name: sort_result
methods.description: Sorts account entries and inserts subtotal lines based on account levels.
